name: HomeSpan
scope: Vendored ESP32 HomeKit Accessory Protocol implementation for the opt-in IoTCloud DAIKIN hub variant
patches: Leave Wi-Fi provisioning, application HTTP, OTA, recovery and the shared mDNS responder under the firmware adapter's ownership.
Avoid Flash or default-NVS initialization in global constructors; require explicit dedicated-partition namespace handles.
Require the adapter's per-device Setup ID and stored SRP verifier; never fall back to a public default pairing PIN.
Bound persisted accessory, controller and database-hash blobs before allocation or copying; latch storage errors until reboot.
Commit accessory identity, pairing changes, verifier and database hash before reporting success; explicitly commit controller deletion.
Provide storage health, initialization readiness and stop interfaces so the adapter can disable HomeKit after persistence errors.
Replace blocking HTTP/encrypted-record reception with bounded incremental framing, strict headers, binary TLV handling and request deadlines.
Bound and validate incoming TLVs before allocating; reject truncated encrypted data and keep pairing/verification state per connection.
Reject zero and out-of-range SRP public keys/verifiers, check MPI/SHA failures and compare client proofs in constant time.
Bound concurrent HAP connections and timed writes; preserve IoTCloud characteristic availability and JSON/HTTP limits.
Bound the actual characteristics parser writes independently of the preliminary JSON field count.
Parse complete numeric JSON values without narrowing overflow; enforce characteristic ranges/valid values and preserve rejected-row errors across service updates.
Reject duplicate characteristic rows/properties before applying writes or subscription changes.
Use the complete 64-bit HAP record nonce counter and close the session instead of reusing a nonce on exhaustion.
Replace iostream/locale serialization with a narrow byte writer while preserving decimal JSON, binary TLVs and 1024-byte encrypted record boundaries.
Skip empty output frames, close sessions after encryption or short-write failures, and retain SHA-384 count/send behavior.
Match TLV malloc/realloc buffers with a free deleter and keep owning HAP output objects noncopyable.

integration_storage.layout: Existing 4 MiB Flash dual-OTA table is retained
integration_storage.claim: Only a completely erased tail may receive the ownership marker
integration_storage.reset: Only recognized owned storage may be erased by the authenticated adapter reset; restart is required
